## Activity

During February 2024, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 82 captures. This represents the total activity reported for the month. The capture activity provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results outlined below. All results in this report relate to the site’s activity during the reporting period.

## Image quality

Of the 82 captures, 8 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 9.8. This measure identifies the proportion of captured images that could not proceed through grading. The image-quality result should be considered alongside the overall capture activity when reviewing the month’s performance.

## Grading

The grading results recorded 10 referable cases. The median lag was 2. These figures summarise the grading outcome and the time between capture and completion of grading during February 2024. Together, the results show the volume assessed, the number of images that could not be graded, the referable findings, and the median grading lag for Hill Counties Health Centre.
